description: agent.duplicate copies one agent row under a new name and returns the new row — a daemon write, not policy authoring, so it is registered like loop.create. The copy carries the source's functionality and metadata (a duplicate that dropped a tool the original had would be a silent narrowing of authority), and the new slug is minted from the name, refusing an empty one.
